Bihar Assembly Constituency Sees Candidate Changes and Nominations

In the Bankipur constituency, political activity is underway with candidates filing nominations for an upcoming election. There are conflicting reports regarding the BJP candidate, with some outlets stating Abhishek Kumar Bunti filed his papers, while others suggest he has withdrawn and Neeraj Sinha will contest. Nitin Naveen has reportedly made statements supporting the candidate.
